headline: Business Intelligence Analyst
summary: Business intelligence analyst with four years in banking and consumer-goods distribution. I design Power BI data models and dashboards, write the SQL behind them, and work with sales and finance leads to decide which measures matter. I also look after the reporting database so figures stay consistent from month to month.

skill_groups.label: Reporting
items: Power BI (DAX, data modelling, row-level access)
business analytics for sales and credit

skill_groups.label: Data
items: statistical techniques: forecasting and variance analysis

experience.title: Business Intelligence Analyst
bullets: Built the company's sales performance dashboards in Power BI, now used weekly by 25 area supervisors across Panay and Guimaras.
Designed a star-schema reporting database and nightly SQL loads from the ordering system.
Introduced a simple demand forecast for fast-moving goods that reduced stock-outs in two warehouses.

experience.title: Data Analyst
bullets: Prepared monthly loan-portfolio and deposit reports for the board using SQL and Excel.
Analysed delinquency by loan product and barangay, which led to a revised collection schedule for farm loans.

education.credential: Bachelor of Science in Applied Mathematics

certifications.name: Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate

projects.name: Board reporting pack
projects.description: Replaced a 40-tab Excel workbook at the rural bank with a six-page Power BI report.
